eventtitle: AgentCore Best Practices: Learnings from KAI, Keppel’s AI Platform
description: As organizations scale AI agent development, robust enterprise architecture becomes essential. This session explores how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore enables modular systems with shared tools via MCP gateways, A2A collaboration, identity-based access controls, and integrated observability. Learn practical strategies for secure runtime deployment, standardized tool integration, and end-to-end monitoring. Keppel will share how they leveraged AgentCore to power customer interactions across their real estate portfolio and manage investor relations through their conversational agent, Ivy. Leave with actionable insights to build secure and scalable agentic architectures leveraging Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
